expected_behavior: Stage one only reads sessions and writes a report and a fix plan; no skill file changes until the user picks fixes from the multi-select panel.
Only the fixes the user picked are applied; each one is checked, a failed check reverts that fix, and the outcome is written to heal-ledger.jsonl.
Each edit names a unique find string that was actually read and replaces only that span, never a whole section.
Deleting a skill or another portfolio change is offered as a question to the user, never applied as an automatic edit.
Instructions that no longer change behaviour are proposed for pruning rather than kept as no-op text.
Keys, tokens, passwords and other credentials in transcripts are redacted before any prompt or report is written, so none reaches the model or the run folder.
source: The environment, not only the skills
